data.name: Dinotraz
data.detailed_description:
You are a criminal being sentenced to death. However, the current goverment has arranged a chance for you to survive. There's an experimental study going on regarding incubating prehistorical animals, located on the island Dinotraz, and since then, this island has been ruled by dinosaurs.

Survive on this island, and hunt for all the items listed on your checklist. If you can successfully collect all the items, you have chosen your life is worthy and will be brought back to civilization for a second chance.

Run around the island, that is filled with trees, rivers, rocks, bushes, and oh yeah dinosaurs. When you get hungry, you better hope you have cooked food on the ready, or else you'll die. You can hunt these dinosaurs and collect their meat to cook. And you'll also want to be on the lookout for the significant items that you must be hunting for.

You can interact with other survivor npcs that have came before you. They sell good weapons and food, for a price of course. You can sell them items to gain money, and then you can buy better weapons. Bows and arrows, rifles and bullets, and spears. You will need these higher tier weapons to survive in the more dangerous areas of the island. So be prepared for what you might encounter

If you survive, your score will be recorded, and you'll be placed on a leader board to brag to all your friends. Or your cat if you dont have any friends.

I dare you to take a challenge, and prove to your superiors that you are worthy to have another chance in the real world, and prove to yourself that you can survive dinotraz.

data.short_description: Hunt, explore, hide, and survive Dinotraz; the dinosaur infested island that has been in use for current studies and discoveries regarding incubating extinct live. Can you retrieve all the items your superiors have ordered you to retrieve to prove yourself worthy and keep your life?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: i7 or Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or rtx 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
